description: This file implements thread-local storage management for tracing, including thread context creation, retrieval, synchronization, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: tr2tls_start_process_clock
methods.description: Initializes the process start time if not already set.

methods.name: tr2tls_create_self
methods.description: Creates and initializes a thread context for the current thread.

methods.name: tr2tls_get_self
methods.description: Retrieves the thread context for the current thread, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: tr2tls_is_main_thread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread is the main thread.

methods.name: tr2tls_unset_self
methods.description: Cleans up and frees the current thread's context.

methods.name: tr2tls_push_self
methods.description: Pushes a new start time onto the thread's region stack.

methods.name: tr2tls_pop_self
methods.description: Pops the most recent start time from the thread's region stack.

methods.name: tr2tls_pop_unwind_self
methods.description: Unwinds all open regions in the thread's stack.

methods.name: tr2tls_region_elasped_self
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time for the current region in the thread.

methods.name: tr2tls_absolute_elapsed
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time since process start.

methods.name: tr2tls_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with thread-local storage system.

methods.name: tr2tls_locked_increment
methods.description: Atomically increments a counter under mutex lock.

methods.name: tr2tls_lock
methods.description: Locks the mutex for thread-safe operations.
